environment_constraints: Do not restart or start the dev server. Do not delete or replace existing working functionality. Do not create new SQL tables or run migrations. Do not put service-role keys in client code. The `createClient` from '@/lib/supabase/client' is for client components. `createClient` from '@/lib/supabase/server' (async, must await) is for server components/route handlers.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md instructs: this is Next.js 16 with breaking API changes. Read docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. The AGENTS.md header block must stay in file. Do not blindly apply older Next.js patterns.
key_patterns: 1) All CSS is in app/globals.css as pixel-retro utility classes: btn-primary, btn-outline, btn-ghost, btn-neon, btn-gold, card, input, label, textarea, select, badge, nav-link, app-container, modal-overlay, modal-content, feed-layout, sidebar-left, sidebar-right, feed-main, animate-pixel-blink. 2) Colors: bg #060a14, card #0d1426, border #1e3560, text #e8f4fd, secondary #a8d4f0, muted #6bafd4, accent-blue #00aaff, accent-mint #00ffcc, accent-yellow #ffe066, accent-red #ff4466. 3) Border-radius: 0px everywhere (pixel retro). 4) Shadow: 4px 4px 0px #000 (card), 3px 3px 0px #003366 (btn-primary), 6px 6px 0px #000 (modal). 5) Inline styles used for pixel-specific values; Tailwind for layout. 6) Components use `displayName()` and `firstName()` from lib/profile.ts for safe name display. 7) `profileWritableFields()` strips role/faculty_status from update payloads. 8) `useAuth()` provides { user, session, profile, loading, signOut, refreshProfile }. 9) `useCommunity()` provides currentUser (= profile from AuthContext), all feed data, and modal setters. 10) All client components have 'use client' at top. Server components (page.tsx files that fetch data) must not have 'use client'. 11) Route handlers use `await createClient()` from '@/lib/supabase/server'. 12) Middleware in lib/supabase/middleware.ts protects /connections, /messages, /faculty/dashboard, /admin. 13) For messages: RPC `get_or_create_direct_conversation(other_user: uuid)` returns conversation id. 14) ConnectButton uses useConnections() hook which uses useAuth() internally. 15) Navbar already has nav links to /people, /connections, /messages, /faculty, /admin. 16) PostCard's handleAuthorClick uses setSelectedProfileForView+setIsProfileModalOpen (modal) not router push - this should be kept or enhanced to also link to /people/[id].
directory_structure: community/ — root. app/ — Next.js App Router (page.tsx, layout.tsx, globals.css, auth/callback/, api/). components/ — shared React components (all 'use client'). contexts/ — AuthContext, CommunityContext, ThemeContext (all 'use client'). hooks/ — useConnections, useMessages (all 'use client'). lib/ — types, profile helpers, utils, validation, supabase clients, logic/. supabase/ — schema.sql. .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts (NEVER inside the app).
